title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-10

ai_review.summary: Nice 1969 soundboard captures a historic set highlighted by Stephen Stills' standout Black Queen performance.
ai_review.review: The show is prized for its historical context – the band road‑testing material that would become Workingman's Dead and featuring a rare guest appearance by Stephen Stills on Black Queen. Reviewers praise the soundboard source as clear and pleasant, though one notes the typical modest fidelity of a late‑1969 board mix. Overall the performance is celebrated despite the lack of a second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star ratings and highlight strong musical moments; recording quality is described as good with only minor vintage limitations, yielding a solid combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and pleasant soundboard capture; reviewers note it’s a typical 1969 board mix – decent but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Historical set with early versions of songs that would later appear on Workingman's Dead; flow described as solid and interesting for fans.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Reviewer expresses nostalgia, missing Ron and Jerry.
